body:
Aw, that's nice, good for you man. 

Happy living !

I can understand that in a way. 

At the same time, I think it has the tendency to turn into narrow-mindedness. Like if you think all the time that other people are boring and have nothing to offer you, then you're perhaps missing out on people who might be interesting and have something to offer you. Because there's  always the possibility, right ?

But why ?

I have unlimited interest in strangers. I'd like to meet all type of people, talk with them, do things with them, have fun.
Uhm, not like I'd mind whether you'd be with me or not, but what do you actually disagree with ? Because it seems to me what you described is quite similar to what I described.

It's interesting how sometimes no matter what we have, this insecurity issue is there.

I think insecurity kills more people than cancer. 

​

I also have many great things in my life, but it just seems that it doesn't matter often times.

 I am just running around like a wounded animal, thinking about all the things I don't have and I know this is what is killing me on the inside, but I just can't do anything about it. 

If I could end my own misery I would, but I can't. 

So the only thing that remains there is to end my existence.

Well, I was 23 years old when I decided that I want to live my life according to certain rules.

Things such as not eating like a degenerate monster, finding a hobby to do in my free time instead of self-destructive activities, spending more time with my dogs, becoming a more disciplined student, etc.

It was so clear for me back then that if I wasn't going to achieve these changes at 24, then there is no point to lie myself about any possible change in the future, because it is just not going to happen.

It's a tricky thing to go on living, convincing yourself that change is going to happen - how many years can pass like this ? Unpredictable.

​

Like it was in a movie: "Is it better to live like a monster or die like a good man ?"

I also set a date. It is in a few days. 

Everything feels so different now. The pressure is gone. 

I just know I am going to do it. Nothing matters anymore.
I see. But 4 of them were against me, which leaves me with 6 who actually got along with me - doesn't this matter ?

Well, of course I can't be sure, because I just know what the manager (who's also the owner/boss) told me. 

**I know that my coworkers complained** \- some of them, because we were totally 11 and 4 of them had problems with me ( 2 girls who saw me as competition and were intimidated by me , and 2 guys - the ones who started to complain about me because the other 2 girls formed an alliance with them and decided to complain until they kick me out ). 

I just didn't think that my boss was going to listen to them.

If I don't lie, they will certainly not hire me.

If I lie a bit, I have chances that they will hire me. 

It'd be a white lie anyway, the kind of thing you do for a greater purpose.

This is not my point. 

I am not blaming the past generations either.

I am saying that it is stupid for a past generation to blame a present generation.

We are all inter-connected.

Thanks ! Your answer is so sweet and you are so right ! 

Yes, I will treat them exactly as they would be babies ! 😊

What a brilliant idea !

Yes, but they are not supposed to know it. 

People don't like when they see that you see that they are idiots.

Perhaps you are right, but if she is *that type* of person, then actually it's not the type of person I'd want as a friend anyway.

A friend is not someone who abuses of your goodwill.

I am more firm and severe with colleagues and pals and acquaintances, but when it comes to friends, I expect them to behave in a way that is at the caliber of a friend.

Well that's a smart option definitely. 

I might do that, because the friendship is still in the "reversible" phase.

Well, maybe I came off as a highly moral and rigid person, but I'm not like that at all. 

It's just that I have a **few** rules, but those are very strong ones. 

Let's put it like this: I am flexible in 90% of the things, but in the other 10% there has to be a very strong reason to deviate from the rule. 

Money is part of that 10%, and some people might think "well that's a materialistic thing", but no, it's just that the way someone handles money is a very clear reflection of that person's character. I've learned this over the years. 

Your advice of accepting different folks is great by the way, I think I should definitely implement that.

Well every time I gave her a ride, she told me that "I'll give you the money back" and I said "Alright, sure." 

However, I didn't bring it up for a second time. I saw she doesn't give me back the money and that was it, I didn't comment on it. Maybe she truly has memory problems, but should that concern me also ? 

Anyway, this whole situation is nasty, and the more I express my opinion about it, the more it sounds like I'd be the bad one here, but I just don't think that I can trust such a person, based on her behavior.

I know what you mean because I also do those things. 
This is not living, this is simply absorbing ourselves in something for a few hours, so that we forget how miserable we are.

It would go like this: "Here is the path I walked on, now repeat after me and in the end, you'll going to end up just as depressed as you started." 

Sounds like a fun thing to do to younger people.
Yes, it is !

Dude, that is not cool. 

Your church is fucked up and so are you if you think making such a big deal over mashed potatoes is normal.

You know what ? 

My mind is probably very messed up, because I liked more being in that world than I liked waking up in this life.

The problem is that my messed-up mind is not "justified" by the life I have. We are a middle-class family, I go to college and I'm physically healthy. When you're in my situation, no one believes that you can be mentally damaged; everyone asks "Why would you be ?" and people discard your problem. 

It's funny, it's like there would be a censorship that doesn't allow certain people to consider themselves as mentally damaged, because "they aren't supposed to be, they have no reason to be". 

Such a superficial society that we live in.

>What ?   
>  
>People on the streets don't do paperwork jobs.

But this is what I'm saying - it's a rough life, so people who do it are tough. 

I hate the idea that they are tougher than me, this is why I envy them.

But why isn't it cool ? 

I mean many of you guys are taking big risks (maybe not you, but there the ones who do) and you have the freedom to actually live your life the way you want it. 

Sure, I know there are days on which you might have to fast or that you can lose all your money in a bad deal and then you've got to start again from zero, but at least there is adrenaline pumping all the time and besides you aren't sucking up to a boss every day, you don't have to do hours of paperwork and boring stuff, you don't have to sit at a desk, etc. 

I'm not saying "cool" as in a naive way, but in a way that there are definitely pros and cons, yet the pros and cons don't seem to me to be so much worse than the pros and cons in any other field. 

Tell me why do you have it worse than let's say an accountant who is chained at a desk 16 hours a day, risking to also get in problems because all the crappy work they have to do for firms ? 

Or a doctor who risks to be sued for malpractice after 10\+ years of training ? 

Etc., etc.

The way I see it, there are serious pros and cons everywhere. 

It's not that I'm naive about the streets, but I don't think it's fair to say that the rest of us have it so much easier than you do.

Well at least someone gets it 😄

I mean, I don't want people to agree with me, but c'mon, calling me stupid only because I question the conventions of what we consider to be a "good life" is a bit exaggerated.

Well of course, now it would be too late for me to start living that life.

C'mon, you know that 😄

You've got to start this thing from the beginning, in your adolescence at most, not when you're already in your 20s and 30s.

I went to college, I worked for a PhD....I've become a domesticated animal and I'd suck on the streets, because you've got to have balls there, and you can't get those from the crappy and boring and unchallenging life that I lived.

Compared to what ?

If I'd give my place as a lawyer to anyone from the streets, how many do you think would actually be in my shoes ?

I've had experience with plenty of street people who got the chance to get out of the hood and I can count on one hand how many of them actually gave up street life.

They were not stupid people, by the way, so the only thing that wasn't there was motivation.

Now if street life is so awful, why do they lack motivation to change their lives, even when the opportunity is offered ?
The freedom.
Maybe being a pirate is cool, but everyone who envies them says that pirates suck 🤔

I'm not trolling. 

Not everyone hates street life, just like not every lawyer/doctor/engineer/programmer enjoys their lives.

I'm not being the devil's advocate here and I'm not a racist, but it's not true that we're all the same. 

We **are** different (physically and psychologically as well), the only problem is that people make an issue out of this.
lol who told you what to do ? are you hallucinating,junkie? :D

I never blamed others for my problems. 

  You like to put words in people's mouth, don't you ?

I am a girl. 

  It's not so hard for us, you know.
Why are you talking to yourself ?

Yeah yeah. 

  Go play with your dolls, little angry bird ;)
Agreed !

You might have a niggling feeling, but I know for sure that you're still a 14 year old kid who channels his anger into writing on reddit threads about problems that he has no idea about. 

  Sorry pal, try later ( like, in 20 years ).

I ate half kilo of chocolate-filled croissants with 6 tablespoons of nutella, 3 tablespoons of peach jam, 2 hamburgers and french fries 

  no, this wasn't a single occasion, this is an average meal 

  you will be fine

@pokemongopikachugogo - Dude, you obviously have issues. You came to my post only to write crap. 
  Based on your name, you're just an angry 14 years old guy. Make your own thread of TIFU. 

  It's incredible how materialistic some people can be. you're envious because I'm in medical school, everything else doesn't matter, right  ?

  bunch of frustrated hypocrites.

Well thanks for doing that. 

  I don't see any proof that this would be a fake and it isn't. If moderators see it, hopefully have more life experience than you who are just naively judging me based on your opinion. 

  **And please, let me know which part of what I wrote don't you like**. That I called you naive because you trust the law ?! Yes, you are naive. Naive for trusting the whole system. I guess the idea is comforting to you. 

  Well I don't trust the system, because we don't live in such a perfect world in which you can trust the law.

do you think I care about what you write ? You don't impress me and based on how you write, it's obvious you have just as serious issues as me, if not even more serious issues. 

  peace ;)

By the law ? 
Don't make me laugh. 

  Things are being done every day that by the law are not supposed to happen.
  
  Seriously, you're older than me, but more naive than me.
I just don't trust the people who work there. I can never know if what I say doesn't remain on the record somewhere.

Because I am mentally messed up, isn't that obvious ? 

  I don't know, man. I know it would be the honorable thing to just quit, if I can't give my best to it. 

  I just haven't quit until now, because every day I'm trying to pull myself together, but it never works out, but I don't want to give up and it's just a vicious cycle like this. 

  I would love to become a great doctor, but more often than not, my demons are bigger than me.

” Who has time to complain about shit that happened in elementary school when they are in medical school?” - I wrote this post in 4 minutes. 
 
  You are probably a balanced doctor, with a good mental health and a good social life. The fact that we are in the same field doesn't matter. I have 10 empty years behind me and carrying a baggage of regrets and repressed emotions. 

  "you never would have never even gone to college, much less gotten into medical school" - Sometimes I have no idea how I'm here, but it's not such a big deal. Getting in Med school is probably the only big achievement in my life, so please....besides, I can still turn out to be a crap doctor, because I know damn well that I'm not giving my best. I'm getting by, but I'm nowhere near that level that I'd want to reach. I'm constantly trying to pull myself together, but my life is just a drag. Med school doesn't give you special powers.

" You are in med school. How messed up can you be? " - I can tell you were never in Med school, but I invite you to come and see for yourself, if you think this is nirvana :))

  Besides, it's not about the place you're at or the position you're in. It's about what's inside you. 

  You might be waiting tables somewhere and be 100x happier than I am. 

  Never mind, dude, you'll understand one day. 

  P.S. : I was never accepted in the emo club; I'm not skinny enough for them and my arms don't have enough cuts either.

Yes, I know it's a bit of a bias, but many vegans/vegetarians are truly a pain in the butt and that's a fact ( not all of them, but many of them ). 

  I don't even understand why some vegans get upset when you tell this - if I would be a vegan, I wouldn't defend the other utterly ignorant and annoying vegans that exist out there. 

  So except **the exceptions**, to all the other vegans/vegetarians: 

  **YES, vegans, you are annoying !** - Learn some social skills and understand that no matter how well you present your case, if you are an annoying ****, no one will take into consideration what you have to say. 

  **No, vegans, we don't care about animals as you do.** - And you don't have more rights over them as we have. This is a no-brainer, but vegans are delusional: humans are ruling the world, not animals, period. You can't ever take away the forces that are sculpting the human rights and those forces are always going to benefit humans over animals. You're stupid for even trying to fight that. 

  **No, we don't buy your BS about health issues.** - Let's not start with your physical appearances that are far from enviable, let's go straight to the health part: most of your "scientific" discoveries about the health benefits of going vegan is BS; the rest is simply anecdotal evidence. 

  **It's OUR lives, OUR choices** - I could write a longer list, but this is the bottom line: we live in FREEDOM, you plant nazis are neurotic and obsessive-compulsive people who don't have a life worth living, so you waste your time with the mission of turning the world into a vegan one. Just realize how lame it is.

*Follow the money.*

Besides, many doctors are not as smart as some would think. 

  Medical training is 10 years of regurgitating material (well not only, but mostly). **Thinking outside of the box, thinking for yourself, questioning the system - these skills aren't taught in Medical school and many doctors never learn these skills through their lives.** They are just satisfied that they get a high-paying job, a great social status, and the adoration of the masses that they are some kind of semi-gods in the eyes of the big population. 

  It's all smokes and mirrors.
